class.name: Box3DSliderJoint
class.brief_description: A prismatic joint: the bodies slide along this node's local X axis.
class.description: A slider. [member body_b] translates relative to [member body_a] along [b]this node's local X axis[/b] (the red arrow of the move gizmo) and cannot rotate -- so aim the travel direction by rotating the joint node. Pistons, lifts, drawers and sliding doors.

method.name: get_motor_force
method.description: Force the motor applied on the last step, in newtons.

method.name: get_speed
method.description: Current speed along the joint axis, in metres per second.

method.name: get_translation
method.description: Current travel along the joint axis, in metres.

members.member: Lowest allowed translation along the axis, in metres.

Force budget the motor may spend to reach [member motor_speed], in newtons. Box3D clamps the motor's impulse to this times the step, so at 0 the motor runs and moves nothing at all -- the usual reason a motor "does not work". The scene dock warns when [member motor_enabled] is on and this is 0.
Drives the slider toward [member motor_speed], within [member max_motor_force].
Target speed along the axis, in metres per second. Sign picks the direction, in the same reversed sense as [member target_translation] when [member body_b] is empty.
Damping ratio of the spring, non-dimensional. 1.0 is critical damping. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Adds a spring pulling the slider toward [member target_translation] instead of holding it rigidly.
Stiffness of the spring, in cycles per second. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.

Position along the joint axis the spring drives toward, in metres, measured as body B relative to body A. [b]With [member body_b] empty the sign is reversed[/b]: the world anchor becomes body B, so [code]target_translation = 1[/code] settles the body at x = -1 along the axis. Verified on a slider; see [Box3DJoint]'s description for why.
Highest allowed translation along the axis, in metres.
